messages:
maria: Heads-up — proposing a small change to the audit surface for routing/policy edits. Need a timeline + compact diff view + NDJSON export for compliance. Thoughts?

jake: +1 on timeline. We have the changefeed but it's noisy and missing rollout context.

sophia: Important: include rollout context (canary %, start/end time, who triggered). Without that audits don't map to incidents or regressions.

kevin: Agreed. Also include quota effects. If a policy reduces per-tenant quota we must show the delta and effective time.

maria: Quick sketch of export shape to discuss (NDJSON per-change):
```ndjson
{"ts":"2026-11-02T21:13:45Z","actor":"kevin","actor_id":"u_123","object_type":"routing_policy","object_id":"route_42","change_type":"update","before":{"match":"*","backend":"gpt-large","quota":1000},"after":{"match":"api/*","backend":"gpt-medium","quota":500},"rollout":{"id":"r_77","mode":"canary","pct":10},"policy_hash":"abc123","redacted":true}
```

lena: Redact secrets/tokens/keys but keep policy_hash + full before/after for internal compliance. Make 'redacted': true explicit in the shape so auditors know we intentionally removed sensitive bits.

kevin: We also need retention/TTL knobs per org for audit exports. Default 90d, enterprise option to extend to 1y. Also think about export encryption at rest and KMS tagging.

sophia: UI ideas: inline diff with arrows between versions, a small timeline slider for rollouts, and ability to 'pin' a version/commit to a support case with comments.

maria: API debate: do we extend existing /changes endpoint or add a new top-level /audit/events? I prefer a dedicated /audit/events.v1 to avoid overloading semantics and to version faster.

jake: New endpoint seems cleaner. Indexing plan: object_type + object_id + ts. Also add query params for rollout_id and actor.

kevin: Search needs partial route id matching and policy_hash lookup. Also support filtering by quota_delta and by which quota dimension changed.

ops-bot: export job queued by maria. Task ID: ex-8821. ETA ~2m :white_check_mark:

maria: Adding owners: @kevin for storage/retention, @jake for API surface, @sophia for UI/UX. Small follow-up: we need telemetry flags to correlate runtime requests that hit old vs new policy for canary analysis.

lena: Can we attach sample traces/metrics in the export? Suggest adding a 'telemetry_refs' array that links to timeseries/trace IDs rather than embedding raw traces.

maria: Good call. Include a 'telemetry_refs' field like ["timeseries:svc.policy.hit.rate:seriesId", "trace:abc..."] in NDJSON.

kevin: Ping on PII review — security needs to sign off on allowed fields and storage duration, especially if we keep path match patterns that could contain tenant IDs.

jake: Noted. I'll set up a 30-min sync with security next Tues and bring a data model draft.

ops-bot: export ex-8821 finished. size 12KB. URL: https://s3.redwood/exports/ex-8821.ndjson :file_folder:

maria: Verified the export. Looks good. I'll open a PR with the schema, migration plan, and UI mocks. Follow-ups: rollout metrics attachment and retention knobs. Thanks all!
